ImageFilesystemEstimate.description: KCS admission/headroom estimate after deduplicating environment, platform, and runner image layers. These bytes are not Pod ephemeral-storage usage.

ephemeralStorageLimitMiB.description: Admitted Pod limit; distinct from observed peak usage and image filesystem layers.

ephemeralStorageRequestMiB.description: Admitted Pod request; excludes image filesystem layers.

peakEphemeralStorageMiB.description: Peak Pod writable-layer, log, and disk-backed emptyDir usage; excludes image layers.

softTimerStartedAt.description: KCS acceptance timestamp for startRunner; this is the sole soft-deadline timer origin.

ephemeralStorageMiB.description: Requested Pod ephemeral-storage for writable layers, logs, and disk-backed emptyDir volumes. OCI image layers are accounted separately by ImageFilesystemEstimate. The platform policy supplies the upper bound.

OpaqueCursor.description: Opaque base64url cursor bound to namespace, job, immutable Pod UID, and role.

OpaquePageToken.description: Opaque base64url token bound to namespace and the complete filter set.

controlCommand.description: The control container's long-lived PID 1 command; API-side exec uses the fixed rpc subcommand.

launcherCommand.description: The runtime container's only PID 1 command.

runnerEntrypoint.description: Child argv executed only by rc-native-launcher after the identity transition.

RunnerCredentialGrantSnapshot.description: KCS projection lifecycle only. projectionTtlSeconds and projectionExpiresAt are not the model-gateway token claim lifetime.

projectionTtlSeconds.description: KCS projection lease only; gateway claim TTL is intentionally not represented.

SafeRelativePath.description: Normalized relative POSIX path with no empty, dot, dot-dot, control, symlink, case, or normalization ambiguity.
